choices.content:
All equilateral triangles are congruent to each
other.
All equilateral triangles are regular polygons.
All equilateral triangles are similar to each other.

question.prompt: Which one of the following statements is false?

solutions.explanation:
Congruent figures must have the same shape and size. Consider two equilateral triangles, one with side length \(1\) and the other with side length \(2\). Their sizes differ, so they are not congruent. This counterexample makes statement A false.

The remaining statements hold. Every triangle is convex: a segment joining any two points of the filled triangle stays within it. An equilateral triangle has three \(60^\circ\) angles, so it is equiangular. Its equal sides and equal angles also make it a regular polygon. Finally, any two equilateral triangles have equal corresponding angles and proportional corresponding sides, so they are similar.

Therefore the false statement is choice \(\mathrm{A}\).
solutions.title: Compare shape and size
